findings.description: Unconditional onChange render replaces focused search on committed search change.
reproduction: Observe replacement search and BODY focus
findings.expected: Retain existing search/control DOM on search change or deliberately restore logical focus.
findings.proposedFix: Return early from onChange when focusSelector is absent; search changes are already handled by onInput.
findings.regression: Dispatch input and committed change on focused search; assert identity and activeElement remain the existing search. Retest existing six DOM checks.
findings.limits: Native pointer target loss is a plausible consequence, not a browser-tested finding.

acceptance.basis: Parent task states owner conditional acceptance after fast review/fixes and packaged skill. This bounded reviewer does not independently amend ledger criteria or acceptance.
acceptance.previousSTD13Meaning: Native keyboard interaction and actual screen-reader output with remaining limits.
acceptance.handoff: Resolve F-01 and retest; package accessibility skill/report. If owner explicitly amended STD-13 exit criterion to scoped engineering review, retain original screen-reader requirement/history and make amendment and residual AT gap explicit. Otherwise STD-13 cannot be closed by this source review. STD-09 acceptance belongs to owner or evidenced standing conditional authorization.

limits: No browser used; no native keyboard, pointer or accessibility-tree inspection performed.
No screen reader run or spoken output; browser and screen-reader versions unavailable because neither was used.
No 320 CSS px reflow, native browser zoom, 200% resize, text-spacing, rendered hover/selection/focus contrast, forced-colours or OS reduced-motion test.
No generated guide content, history chart/table, complete tracker shell, delivery disclosures or deep-link/history process checked.
Prior Edge observations in ACCESSIBILITY.md were read as historical claims, not repeated or converted into new passes.
No automated full-page accessibility scanner run. Six unit regressions and a role palette checker do not establish WCAG conformance.
Review made no repository edits, ledger update, external write, publication or deployment. Report written only to delegated scratch output.
Criterion not-applicable was not assigned merely from absence in the bounded files; complete page applicability remains to be assessed.
